v32_contract.marker_source: src/arch/aarch64/boot.S assembly pre-entry provenance, src/main.rs rust_entry normal path, src/boot/rpi5.rs kernel_main, and src/target/rpi5.rs run_ssh_service_smoltcp_runtime_ready_route via UART10 early-phase writes
redaction_rules: Retain marker names, counts, hashes, byte counts, classifications, and lab identity summaries.

Do not retain raw serial text, raw TFTP peer/log-line fields, packet payloads, SSH/session/key material, boot artifact bytes, private user data, stable secret-derived identifiers, or unnecessary hardware data.
v32_contract.qualitatively_different_from_v30: v30 searched Rust and later normal-runtime markers only. v32 must first prove or disprove selected Image execution before rust_entry by checking assembly asm_start and asm_pre_rust_entry markers emitted before CPACR setup, BSS clear, stack setup, Rust entry, BootInfo, target init, exceptions, kernel_main, networking, or service code.

findings.finding: The selected normal-runtime scenario did not request the assembly early-entry provenance markers, leaving v30 unable to distinguish failure before _start/pre-rust from failure at rust_entry. build.rs now enables TALOS_RPI5_EARLY_ENTRY_PROVENANCE_SCENARIO for rpi5_ssh_service_smoltcp_runtime_ready.
The runtime-ready archive review did not fail-close on assembly pre-entry marker absence. It now requires TALOS: asm_start and TALOS: asm_pre_rust_entry in addition to the runtime route tokens.

The capture bundle final summary jq program referenced $marker_family without passing --arg marker_family. The final summary now receives the marker family, matching dry-run and preflight identity summaries.

The normal Rust path remains selected for rpi5_ssh_service_smoltcp_runtime_ready; rust_entry, BootInfoParsed, TargetInit, ExceptionsReady, kernel_main, route-start, and runtime-ready source writes remain in place.

The selected archive keeps the same 152144-byte Image size/header shape and selected da591740/kernel_2712.img mirror contract while changing the kernel SHA because the assembly provenance markers are now linked in.

Packet-I/O, OpenSSH/generated-root retry, remote receipt, compatibility/service readiness, ssh-ready=true, fake command expansion, broad shell work, and phase transition remain rejected as mechanically unblocked successors.
